claim_evidence_alignment.pass: Every major claim has a method, experiment, figure/table, citation, or limitation anchor.
claim_evidence_alignment.fail: A major claim remains unsupported or stronger than its evidence.

story_spine.pass: Problem, gap, insight, method, evidence, boundary, and implication form a dependency chain.
story_spine.fail: Sections are individually plausible but the paper story breaks.

sentence_necessity.pass: Each sentence has function, necessity, placement, connection, and evidence boundary.
sentence_necessity.fail: Decorative, redundant, misplaced, or disconnected sentences remain.

paragraph_transition.pass: Adjacent paragraphs have explicit logical relations and each paragraph makes the next necessary.
paragraph_transition.fail: Paragraphs are individually plausible but can be swapped, skipped, or reordered without clear damage.

section_dependency.pass: Abstract, Introduction, Methods, Experiments, Discussion, and Conclusion claims constrain one another.
section_dependency.fail: Sections make promises that are not supported by later sections, or conclusions revive unsupported claims.

ai_smell.pass: Generic importance, adjective stacks, vague subjects, and mechanical connectors are removed or justified.
ai_smell.fail: The output is fluent but generic, promotional, or template-like.

venue_awareness.pass: Target venue family affects limitations, reproducibility, figures, citations, and disclosure checks.
venue_awareness.fail: Venue needs are ignored or only named.

response_truthfulness.pass: Every response claim maps to completed evidence, planned work, or author input needed.
response_truthfulness.fail: The response implies unverified manuscript changes.

validation_honesty.pass: All readiness claims use verified status vocabulary and name checks not run.
validation_honesty.fail: Dry reading or partial checks are upgraded to ready.
